instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: University students often end up rich in ((knowledge)) and poor in finances.
atoms.finishSound: University students often end up rich in knowledge and poor in finances.

atoms.b: It is ((important)) to care for your elders.
atoms.finishSound: It is important to care for your elders.
His mother was therefore not amused.

atoms.b: His ((experiment)) with going to art school worked out better than expected.
atoms.finishSound: His experiment with going to art school worked out better than expected.

atoms.b: She paid ((particular)) attention, so she wouldn’t make the tower fall over.
atoms.finishSound: She paid particular attention, so she wouldn’t make the tower fall over.
They accidentally walked into each other.
Occasionally, a squirrel would pass by.
